sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The TSSAA is a private group that sets rules for high school sports. Brentwood Academy is a private school that joined the group. The school wants to recruit players from other schools. The TSSAA banned this practice. The school sued the group. The lower court ruled for the school. The TSSAA asked the Supreme Court to review the case.
